Software Development Engineer — Full Stack
Company: TechNova Solutions
Location: Bengaluru, India
Experience: 0–2 years
Employment: Full-time
About the Role
We are looking for a motivated Software Development Engineer to join our engineering team. The ideal candidate should have a strong foundation in software development and experience building web applications using modern frontend and backend technologies.
Responsibilities
- Develop and maintain scalable web applications.
- Build responsive user interfaces using React.js.
- Develop RESTful APIs using Node.js and Express.js.
- Design and work with databases such as MongoDB and MySQL.
- Write clean, maintainable, and reusable code.
- Debug and troubleshoot application issues.
- Collaborate with frontend, backend, and product teams in an Agile/Scrum environment.
- Participate in code reviews and contribute to technical discussions.
- Write unit and integration tests for applications.
- Deploy applications using cloud platforms such as AWS.
Required Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
- Strong knowledge of JavaScript.
- Hands-on experience with React.js.
- Experience with Node.js and Express.js.
- Knowledge of MongoDB or MySQL.
- Understanding of REST APIs.
- Knowledge of Git and GitHub.
- Good understanding of Data Structures and Algorithms.
- Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
Preferred Skills
- Experience with TypeScript.
- Familiarity with Python or Java.
- Knowledge of Docker and containerization.
- Familiarity with AWS services such as EC2, S3, and Lambda.
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines.
- Knowledge of Redis or other caching technologies.
- Familiarity with automated testing frameworks such as Jest or Cypress.
Experience
- 0–2 years of software development experience.
- Internship or significant academic/project experience in full-stack development will be considered.
What We Offer
- Opportunity to work on production-scale applications.
- Exposure to cloud technologies and modern development practices.
- Collaborative and learning-oriented engineering environment.
- Opportunities for professional growth.
